name: 修改完成时间
desc: 详情弹窗里已完成（含已归档）的任务显示可编辑的完成时间行（datetime-local，绑定 statusChangedAt）；未完成/垃圾桶任务不显示；修改后落盘、列表副标题随之更新；把输入框清空不会删除原来的完成时间（保留原值）；老数据（已完成但未记录完成时间）显示“原数据未记录，可在此补填”并可补填。

steps.eval: T.wipe = async () => { const flag = { id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 }; sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify(flag)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); }; await T.wipe();

T.R = () => document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot; T.openRow = async (text) => { const body = Array.from(T.R().querySelectorAll('.item .body')).find(b => b.textContent.indexOf(text) !== -1); if (!body) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + text); body.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); }; T.closeDialog = async () => { const dlg = Array.from(T.R().querySelectorAll('st-dialog')).find(d => d.hasAttribute('open')); const btn = Array.from(dlg.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find(b => b.textContent.indexOf('关闭') !== -1); btn.shadowRoot.querySelector('button').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); }; await T.R().querySelector('.shell'); const items = T.R().querySelectorAll('.item'); if (items.length !== 3) throw new Error('应有 3 条任务，实际 ' + items.length); await T.openRow('已完成甲'); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); if (!row || row.className.indexOf('hidden') !== -1) throw new Error('已完成任务的完成时间行不应隐藏'); const inp = row.querySelector('input[type=datetime-local]'); if (!inp || !inp.value) throw new Error('完成时间未预填'); return { value: inp.value, hint: row.querySelector('.done-at-hint').textContent };

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); T.store = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); const inp = row.querySelector('input[type=datetime-local]'); inp.value = '2026-10-01T08:30'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const ta = (await T.store.getItem('todos')).find(t => t.id === 'ta'); if (!ta || ta.statusChangedAt !== new Date('2026-10-01T08:30').getTime()) throw new Error('statusChangedAt 未写回存储：' + (ta && ta.statusChangedAt)); return { stored: ta.statusChangedAt };

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); T.store = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); const inp = row.querySelector('input[type=datetime-local]'); const before = (await T.store.getItem('todos')).find(t => t.id === 'ta').statusChangedAt; inp.value = ''; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = (await T.store.getItem('todos')).find(t => t.id === 'ta').statusChangedAt; if (after !== before) throw new Error('清空输入框把原完成时间弄丢了：' + before + ' → ' + after); const shown = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row input[type=datetime-local]').value; if (!shown) throw new Error('清空后输入框未恢复原值'); return { kept: after, inputShown: shown };

await T.closeDialog(); const ta = Array.from(T.R().querySelectorAll('.item')).find(i => i.textContent.indexOf('已完成甲') !== -1); const meta = ta.querySelector('.meta').textContent; if (meta.indexOf('10-01 08:30') === -1) throw new Error('列表副标题未显示新完成时间：' + meta); await T.openRow('未完成乙'); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); if (!row || row.className.indexOf('hidden') === -1) throw new Error('未完成任务不应显示完成时间行'); await T.closeDialog(); return { meta };

await T.openRow('老数据丙'); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); if (!row || row.className.indexOf('hidden') !== -1) throw new Error('老数据（已完成未记录时间）应显示完成时间行'); const inp = row.querySelector('input[type=datetime-local]'); if (inp.value !== '') throw new Error('老数据不应有预填值：' + inp.value); const hint = row.querySelector('.done-at-hint').textContent; if (hint.indexOf('未记录') === -1) throw new Error('老数据缺少“未记录可补填”提示：' + hint); inp.value = '2026-09-15T09:00'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const store = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const tc = (await store.getItem('todos')).find(t => t.id === 'tc'); if (tc.statusChangedAt !== new Date('2026-09-15T09:00').getTime()) throw new Error('补填未落盘：' + tc.statusChangedAt); return { hint, stored: tc.statusChangedAt };

await T.closeDialog(); const now = Date.now(); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const store = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const todos = await store.getItem('todos'); todos.find(t => t.id === 'ta').archivedAt = now; await store.setItem('todos', todos); return 'archived';

T.R = () => document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot; await T.R().querySelector('.shell'); const btns = Array.from(T.R().querySelectorAll('st-button')); const arch = btns.find(b => b.textContent.indexOf('已归档') !== -1); arch.shadowRoot.querySelector('button').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const item = T.R().querySelector('.item.archived'); if (!item) throw new Error('归档视图没有条目'); item.querySelector('.body').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const row = T.R().querySelector('.done-at-row'); if (!row || row.className.indexOf('hidden') !== -1) throw new Error('已归档的已完成任务应显示完成时间行'); const inp = row.querySelector('input[type=datetime-local]'); if (inp.value !== '2026-10-01T08:30') throw new Error('归档任务预填值错误：' + inp.value); inp.value = '2026-09-20T22:00'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const store = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const ta = (await store.getItem('todos')).find(t => t.id === 'ta'); if (ta.statusChangedAt !== new Date('2026-09-20T22:00').getTime()) throw new Error('归档任务修改未落盘'); return 'archive-edit-ok';

sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const ts = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); await ts.setItem('todos', []); await ts.setItem('groups', []); return 'restored';
